def evolved_p96(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i, j] = popcount(i XOR j) = Hamming distance between i and j.
    # Position-based, output (N, N). N=16 -> values 0..15 need 4 bits.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device, dtype=torch.int64)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N, 1)
    b = torch.tensor([1, 2, 4, 8], device=x.device, dtype=torch.int64).view(1, 1, 4)
    bi = (ii // b) % 2
    bj = (jj // b) % 2
    out = ((bi + bj) % 2).sum(-1)
    return out.to(x.dtype)
